# caveman

Switches replies into a compressed style for the rest of the session: no pleasantries, no hedging, no narration of tool calls. Numbers, code, error strings, and negations stay exact, and the style steps aside for security warnings and for anything a reader could misread when compressed.

## Skills

| Skill | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`caveman`](skills/caveman/README.md) | Answer in a compressed caveman register that drops filler and keeps every technical fact, for the rest of the session. Use for /caveman, "caveman mode", "talk like caveman", "be brief" or "less tokens". |

## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
/plugin install caveman@Uraxii
```

Codex CLI:

```
codex plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai --ref main
codex plugin add caveman@uraxii
```

Copilot CLI:

```
copilot plugin marketplace add Uraxii/dotai
copilot plugin install caveman@Uraxii
```

For other harnesses, see the [repository README](https://github.com/Uraxii/dotai#install).
